_what: THE CROP TEST — one of each kind (RUNNING_LOG §71, 2026-10-05; his word: "test the cropping for one of each kind … the impulses or whatever, multiphonics, whatever I decide to use"). node tools/elec.js croptest sends each kind through the rack on a SCRATCH bank with the tool's own engine (his must be down) and draws the result on http://localhost:5500/crop_test/report.html. A kind: the player (a name in elec_route.json players), the key, the preset (cc0 = preset − 1; none for a struck lane), the channel (the percussion's instrument), the note's length, a category. The window is 4 s for all — the note's sender takes a moment to start; the crop finds the attack wherever it falls.
